t: Ahead of you at Holborn Circus is the equestrian statue of Prince Albert. Albert was Queen Victoria's husband, and consort of the monarch from their marriage in February 1840 until his death in 1861. Victoria gave him the title Prince Consort in 1857. The sculptor was Charles Bacon, who is remembered chiefly for this very statue. The setting was designed by the architects Philip Charles Hardwick and William Haywood.
